_comment: Shared strict compiler options for every workspace in this repo.
Package tsconfigs extend this and override only what is genuinely
per-package: target, lib, module/moduleResolution, jsx, paths, outDir.

build context is vps-scraper/ alone, so a parent-relative extends
would break the image build. It mirrors these options inline.
